destinations.name: Kyoto
destinations.tagline: Seat of the emperors for more than a thousand years
destinations.description: The city kept its wooden machiya townhouses because it was spared the heavy bombing of 1945. Gion and Higashiyama still have whole streets of them.
destinations.bestMonths: March to May, October to November
destinations.airport: Osaka Kansai (KIX), 75 min by Haruka train

experiences.title: Fushimi Inari early
experiences.line: Torii tunnels up Mount Inari, best before the crowds arrive

experiences.title: Arashiyama bamboo grove
experiences.line: Then cross Togetsukyō Bridge over the Katsura

experiences.title: Nishiki Market lunch
experiences.line: A covered food street; try tamagoyaki and Kyoto pickles

destinations.name: Santorini
destinations.tagline: Cliff villages on the rim of a flooded caldera
destinations.description: The cliffs are the inner wall of a volcano that collapsed in the Late Bronze Age. Excavators at Akrotiri found jars of fava seed, the legume the island still grows.
destinations.bestMonths: May to June, September to October
destinations.airport: Santorini (JTR), 15 min by road to Fira

experiences.title: Fira to Oia on foot
experiences.line: The caldera path, three to four hours along the cliff top

experiences.title: Kamari beach
experiences.line: Dark volcanic sand below the rock of Mesa Vouno

experiences.title: Palea Kameni hot springs
experiences.line: Swim from the boat into warm, rust-coloured water

destinations.name: Bali
destinations.tagline: Rice terraces inland, reef breaks to the south
destinations.description: Bali is a Hindu island in a mostly Muslim country, and offerings in palm-leaf trays sit on doorsteps every morning. The subak canals that water its rice terraces date back at least to the 9th century.
destinations.bestMonths: April to October
destinations.airport: Bali Ngurah Rai (DPS), about 90 min by road to Ubud

experiences.title: Tegallalang terraces
experiences.line: Stepped rice fields in a valley north of Ubud

experiences.title: Uluwatu Temple
experiences.line: A clifftop temple, with the kecak dance staged at sunset

experiences.title: Mount Batur sunrise
experiences.line: A two-hour climb in the dark to the crater rim

destinations.name: Lago di Braies
destinations.tagline: A lake at 1,496 m in the Fanes-Sennes-Braies park
destinations.description: The Croda del Becco, 2,810 m, rises from the south shore. In winter the lake freezes over and the rowing boats come out of the water.
destinations.bestMonths: June to September
destinations.airport: Innsbruck (INN), about 2 h by car

experiences.title: Lakeshore loop
experiences.line: A flat hour on a 3.5 km path around the water

experiences.title: Rowing from the boathouse
experiences.line: Wooden boats from the jetty, summer only

experiences.title: Start of the Alta Via 1
experiences.line: Trail 1 climbs from the lake to Rifugio Biella

destinations.name: Zermatt
destinations.tagline: Car-free village under the Matterhorn
destinations.description: Petrol cars stop at Täsch, and the village runs on small electric vehicles. The first ascent of the Matterhorn set out from here in 1865.
destinations.bestMonths: December to April, July to September
destinations.airport: Zurich (ZRH), about 3.5 h by train via Visp

experiences.title: Gornergrat railway
experiences.line: Rack railway from the village up to 3,089 m

experiences.title: Five Lakes Walk
experiences.line: Blauherd to Sunnegga, past the Matterhorn in Stellisee

experiences.title: Klein Matterhorn
experiences.line: Cable cars up to the glacier station at 3,883 m

destinations.name: Tulum
destinations.tagline: Maya walls on a cliff above the Caribbean
destinations.description: Tulum was one of the last cities the Maya built, and people still lived in it when Spanish ships arrived. This coast has no rivers: rain drains straight into the limestone and fills the cenotes.
destinations.bestMonths: November to April
destinations.airport: Tulum (TQO), about 40 min by road

experiences.title: Gran Cenote
experiences.line: Clear water and caverns, a short ride up the Cobá road

experiences.title: Tulum ruins
experiences.line: The walled site, then the beach below El Castillo

experiences.title: Sian Ka'an by boat
experiences.line: Lagoons and mangrove channels in the biosphere reserve

destinations.name: Porto
destinations.tagline: Port lodges on one bank, tiled churches on the other
destinations.description: The two-deck Dom Luís I bridge, opened in 1886, carries the metro on top and cars below. Across it in Vila Nova de Gaia, port wine ages in the riverside lodges.
destinations.bestMonths: May to June, September to October
destinations.airport: Porto (OPO), 30 min by metro (line E)

experiences.title: São Bento station
experiences.line: About 20,000 azulejo tiles in the entrance hall

experiences.title: Francesinha lunch
experiences.line: A meat sandwich under melted cheese and beer sauce

experiences.title: Six bridges cruise
experiences.line: A short river trip under the Douro bridges

destinations.name: Istanbul
destinations.tagline: A ferry city on the Bosphorus
destinations.description: Hagia Sophia, finished in 537, was a church for nine centuries before it became a mosque in 1453. Commuter ferries cross from Europe to Asia in about 20 minutes.
destinations.bestMonths: April to May, September to October
destinations.airport: Istanbul (IST), about 1 h by road to Sultanahmet

experiences.title: Galata Tower
experiences.line: The 14th-century Genoese tower above Karaköy

experiences.title: Grand Bazaar
experiences.line: About 60 covered streets, begun in the 1450s

experiences.title: Balık ekmek at Eminönü
experiences.line: Grilled mackerel in bread by the Galata Bridge

destinations.name: Marrakech
destinations.tagline: A red-walled medina on the plain below the High Atlas
destinations.description: The medina walls run for 19 km, built of rammed earth that gives the city its colour. The 12th-century minaret of the Koutoubia, 77 m tall, shows above most of the old town.
destinations.bestMonths: March to May, October to November
destinations.airport: Marrakech Menara (RAK), 20 min by road to the medina

experiences.title: Jemaa el-Fnaa stalls
experiences.line: Evening food stalls; order harira and grilled merguez

experiences.title: Bahia Palace
experiences.line: Courtyards of zellij tile under painted cedar ceilings

experiences.title: Walks from Imlil
experiences.line: Atlas valley paths below Toubkal, 90 min by road

destinations.name: Hội An
destinations.tagline: Trading port of yellow shophouses and paper lanterns
destinations.description: Japanese and Chinese merchants traded here from the 15th to the 19th century, and the old town is a UNESCO site. The Thu Bồn floods most autumns, and some houses mark each year's water level on their walls.
destinations.bestMonths: February to April
destinations.airport: Da Nang (DAD), about 45 min by road

experiences.title: Lantern boat on the river
experiences.line: An evening boat with paper lanterns on the Thu Bồn

experiences.title: Cao lầu at a street stall
experiences.line: Thick noodles with pork and greens, very little broth

experiences.title: Ride to An Bàng beach
experiences.line: A flat 5 km bike ride through rice fields to the sea

destinations.name: Prague
destinations.tagline: Gothic spires on both banks of the Vltava
destinations.description: Charles Bridge was begun in 1357, and 30 statues line its stone parapets. Up on the hill above Malá Strana, the castle is one of the largest castle complexes in the world.
destinations.bestMonths: May to June, September
destinations.airport: Prague (PRG), 40 min by Airport Express bus

experiences.title: Astronomical clock
experiences.line: The clock on the Old Town Hall, installed in 1410

experiences.title: Petřín hill
experiences.line: Orchard paths from Malá Strana to the lookout tower

experiences.title: Vyšehrad ramparts
experiences.line: Fortress walls above the river, south of the centre

destinations.name: Cartagena
destinations.tagline: Colonial balconies inside Caribbean sea walls
destinations.description: Spain walled the port after repeated pirate raids, and the work took nearly two centuries to finish. Getsemaní, just outside the walls, has the street murals.
destinations.bestMonths: December to April
destinations.airport: Cartagena (CTG), 10 min by road

experiences.title: Walk the ramparts
experiences.line: Along the wall from Las Bóvedas toward the Clock Tower

experiences.title: Castillo de San Felipe
experiences.line: The Spanish fortress on San Lázaro hill and its tunnels

experiences.title: Rosario Islands
experiences.line: Snorkel the coral reefs, an hour or so by boat

destinations.name: Amalfi Coast
destinations.tagline: Cliff towns on the south side of the Sorrento peninsula
destinations.description: Amalfi was a maritime republic trading across the Mediterranean from the 9th to the 11th century. Lemons for limoncello grow on terraces held up by dry-stone walls above the towns.
destinations.bestMonths: May to June, September to October
destinations.airport: Naples (NAP), about 90 min by road to Positano

experiences.title: Path of the Gods
experiences.line: Agerola to Nocelle, high above the sea

experiences.title: Positano by sea
experiences.line: Seasonal ferries, spring to autumn, along the cliffs

experiences.title: Ravello gardens
experiences.line: Terraces at Villa Cimbrone, 350 m above the sea

destinations.name: Dubrovnik
destinations.tagline: Limestone streets inside a complete ring of walls
destinations.description: Most of the old town was rebuilt in stone after the earthquake of 1667. Stradun, the main street, has been worn smooth and pale by centuries of feet.
destinations.bestMonths: May to June, September to October
destinations.airport: Dubrovnik (DBV), 30 to 40 min by airport bus

experiences.title: City walls circuit
experiences.line: Towers and ramparts on a 2 km loop above the sea

experiences.title: Kayak to Lokrum
experiences.line: Paddle out to the island facing the old harbour

experiences.title: Srđ cable car
experiences.line: Up to 405 m for the view over the old town

destinations.name: Cape Town
destinations.tagline: Table Mountain above, the Atlantic below
destinations.description: The Dutch East India Company set up a supply station here in 1652 to feed its ships. Robben Island, 11 km offshore, held political prisoners until 1991.
destinations.bestMonths: November to March
destinations.airport: Cape Town (CPT), 25 min by road to the city centre

experiences.title: Platteklip Gorge
experiences.line: The direct route up the front of Table Mountain

experiences.title: Boulders Beach penguins
experiences.line: African penguins on granite coves near Simon's Town

experiences.title: Constantia wine farms
experiences.line: Tastings on some of the country's oldest estates

destinations.name: Hạ Long Bay
destinations.tagline: Karst towers in the Gulf of Tonkin
destinations.description: UNESCO counts some 1,600 islands and islets in the bay, most of them uninhabited. Most boats leave from Tuần Châu harbour, on an island joined to the mainland by a causeway.
destinations.bestMonths: March to April, October to November
destinations.airport: Hanoi Nội Bài (HAN), about 2.5 h by road

experiences.title: A night on the bay
experiences.line: An overnight boat anchored among the karsts

experiences.title: Kayak through Luồn Cave
experiences.line: Paddle under the rock arch into the lagoon behind it

experiences.title: Sửng Sốt Cave
experiences.line: Large chambers on Bồ Hòn island, up a stone stairway

destinations.name: Big Sur
destinations.tagline: The Santa Lucia Mountains meeting the Pacific
destinations.description: Highway 1 along this coast opened in 1937, built partly with convict labour. Landslides close sections of it for months at a time, so check the road status before driving through.
destinations.bestMonths: April to May, September to October
destinations.airport: Monterey (MRY), about 45 min by road

experiences.title: Bixby Creek Bridge
experiences.line: The 1932 concrete arch, seen from the north pullout

experiences.title: McWay Falls overlook
experiences.line: A waterfall onto the sand, at the end of a short trail

experiences.title: Point Lobos
experiences.line: The Cypress Grove trail above coves with sea otters

destinations.name: Zanzibar
destinations.tagline: Coral-stone streets and an Indian Ocean reef
destinations.description: In the 19th century, clove plantations worked by enslaved people made the island the world's largest clove producer. Stone Town's Anglican cathedral stands on the site of the slave market closed in 1873.
destinations.bestMonths: June to October
destinations.airport: Zanzibar (ZNZ), 15 min by road to Stone Town

experiences.title: Forodhani night market
experiences.line: Grilled seafood on the Stone Town waterfront

experiences.title: Spice farm walk
experiences.line: Clove and nutmeg trees on the farms outside town

experiences.title: Mnemba Atoll
experiences.line: Snorkel the reef by boat from Matemwe

destinations.name: Banff
destinations.tagline: Turquoise lakes in the Canadian Rockies
destinations.description: Hot springs found on Sulphur Mountain in 1883 led to Canada's first national park two years later. Lake Louise and Moraine Lake take their colour from glacial rock flour.
destinations.bestMonths: June to September, December to March
destinations.airport: Calgary (YYC), about 90 min by road

experiences.title: Lake Agnes Tea House
experiences.line: A summer-only hut, 3.5 km uphill from Lake Louise

experiences.title: Banff Gondola
experiences.line: Eight minutes up to the summit ridge boardwalk

experiences.title: Icefields Parkway
experiences.line: Bow Lake and Peyto Lake on the road toward Jasper

destinations.name: Torres del Paine
destinations.tagline: Granite towers above glacial lakes in Patagonia
destinations.description: The three granite towers that name the park rise above the Patagonian steppe. Guanacos graze close to the park roads.
destinations.bestMonths: November to March
destinations.airport: Puerto Natales (PNT, seasonal) or Punta Arenas (PUQ), 2 to 5 h by road

experiences.title: Mirador Base Las Torres
experiences.line: A long day hike to the lake under the three towers

experiences.title: Grey Glacier by boat
experiences.line: Across Lago Grey to the face of the ice

experiences.title: French Valley
experiences.line: The middle arm of the W Trek, under hanging glaciers

destinations.name: Hallstatt
destinations.tagline: Salt-mining village on the Hallstätter See
destinations.description: Salt has been mined in the mountain since the Bronze Age. The early Iron Age Hallstatt culture is named after the graves found above the village. The churchyard is so small that graves were reused, and the bone house holds more than 600 painted skulls.
destinations.bestMonths: May to June, September to October
destinations.airport: Salzburg (SZG), about 1 h 15 min by road

experiences.title: Hallstatt salt mine
experiences.line: Ride the miners' wooden slides inside the mountain

experiences.title: 5fingers platform
experiences.line: Cable car up the Krippenstein to a steel lookout

experiences.title: Ferry from the station
experiences.line: The lake crossing from the railway into the village

destinations.name: Lofoten
destinations.tagline: Granite peaks rising from the Norwegian Sea
destinations.description: The islands lie above the Arctic Circle, yet the Gulf Stream keeps their harbours free of ice. From late winter into spring, cod hangs on wooden racks to dry into stockfish.
destinations.bestMonths: June to August, February to March
destinations.airport: Harstad/Narvik Evenes (EVE), about 3 h by road to Svolvær

experiences.title: Reinebringen
experiences.line: Stone steps up to the view over Reine and its fjord

experiences.title: Kayak from Henningsvær
experiences.line: Paddle between the skerries off the harbour

experiences.title: Aurora at Skagsanden
experiences.line: An open beach on Flakstadøya for clear winter nights

destinations.name: Plitvice Lakes
destinations.tagline: Sixteen lakes joined by waterfalls
destinations.description: Travertine barriers, built up from moss and calcium carbonate, hold the lakes back and are still growing. The park was declared in 1949, the first in Croatia.
destinations.bestMonths: April to June, September to October
destinations.airport: Zagreb (ZAG), about 2 h by road

experiences.title: Lower Lakes boardwalk
experiences.line: Walkways over the water to the foot of Veliki slap

experiences.title: Boat across Kozjak
experiences.line: The electric boat over the largest lake in the park

experiences.title: Upper Lakes trail
experiences.line: Past Galovac and on up to Prošćansko jezero

destinations.name: Queenstown
destinations.tagline: Ski fields and vineyards around Lake Wakatipu
destinations.description: The town grew out of the 1862 gold rush on the Shotover River. Lake Wakatipu runs 80 km in a long zigzag between the mountains.
destinations.bestMonths: December to March, June to August
destinations.airport: Queenstown (ZQN), about 15 min by road

experiences.title: Ben Lomond summit
experiences.line: A full-day climb from the gondola top to 1,748 m

experiences.title: Milford Sound cruise
experiences.line: A boat along the fiord under Mitre Peak
